id: title:arthurdedeus:set account property source concurrency by flag

review.posthog_relevance: Adds configuration and execution parameters for warehouse account property synchronization workflows, including a default concurrency constant, a workflow input parameter, and a feature flag for team-specific concurrency control.
review.reason: The chunk implements a bounded, substantive improvement to warehouse account property synchronization by adding a default concurrency constant, passing concurrency through workflow inputs, and introducing a feature flag for team-specific configuration. This establishes a clear, bounded capability and configuration mechanism. No tier 3 systemic risk reduction or tier 1 narrow-only,
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the implementation of the fanout workflow or account property fanout flag, so the tier cannot be established. No score.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the fanout workflow or the account property fanout flag, so the tier cannot be established. No score.

observations.behavior: Adds a default concurrency constant and a new concurrency parameter to AccountPropertySyncInput.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a fallback concurrency value for warehouse account property sync workflows.

observations.behavior: Adds concurrency parameter to AccountPropertySyncInput and assigns the default.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the concurrency value to be passed through the workflow input.

observations.behavior: Adds a new feature flag for source concurrency and its payload key, and a maximum concurrency cap.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog to configure concurrency per team via a feature flag, while retaining a hard cap.
